description: Looping work/rest interval timer with round tracking, phase beeps and a progress bar — for HIIT, Tabata and focus sprints.

faqs.a: Yes — set any work and rest lengths in seconds and any number of rounds. A common Tabata setup is 20s work / 10s rest × 8 rounds.
faqs.q: Can I use it for Tabata?

faqs.a: Three short beeps count down the last 3 seconds of each phase; a longer beep marks every phase change.
The timer stops after the final work phase — there is no rest after the last round.
faqs.q: Is there a rest after the last round?

howto: Enter work seconds, rest seconds and number of rounds.
Watch the phase, round indicator and progress bar.
Press Stop anytime to end the session.
title: Interval Repeater Timer
